subject: Interconnect claim validation & diagram pack
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <ay.chen@brightbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBank Security <security@brightbank.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Interconnect details & claims for Dedicated deployment

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our security team asked me to collect the formal artifacts that back up Redwood's interconnect and isolation claims for a Dedicated (reserved capacity) deployment. Specifically they requested:

- A network diagram showing the control plane and data plane boundaries (cross-region/failover flows called out)
- A short narrative (1 page max) that states the claim (e.g., "control plane logically separated, no tenant data in control plane") and points to the diagram annotations
- A control-to-evidence mapping (SIG/CAIQ controls) that references specific diagram elements and any logs or retention policies

Can you put together a small pack and confirm whether we can get it by EOD 2026-12-23? If there are any CAIQ fields you can't map, flag them and we'll triage with our reviewers.

Appreciate it — Alyssa

--
Alyssa Chen
Security Review Lead, BrightBank
alyssa.chen@brightbank.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <ay.chen@brightbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interconnect details & claims for Dedicated deployment

Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. We're on it.

Quick plan:
- Attached: interconnect_diagram_v3.pdf (diagram + callouts), controlplane_claim_matrix.xlsx (initial CAIQ/SIG mapping)
- We'll add a 1-page narrative (interconnect_narrative_onepager.docx) that states the claims and references diagram labels (CP=control plane, DP=data plane, Fallback links).
- Kimberly and Karthik will review labeling and any statements that touch hardware-level claims. Naomi will confirm log retention pointers.

If that works I can circulate a final pack by Monday 2026-12-20 and we can iterate based on your reviewers' feedback.

Attaching the files now for your preliminary review.

Jordan Blake
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interconnect details & claims for Dedicated deployment

Jordan — thanks for the draft pack. A few rapid notes (inline so we keep a clear audit trail):

> Attached: interconnect_diagram_v3.pdf (diagram + callouts), controlplane_claim_matrix.xlsx (initial CAIQ/SIG mapping)

- Diagram: please add explicit callouts for PrivateLink/VPN endpoints (we use "PL" callout in other deliverables) and label the east-west VXLAN overlay where applicable. Also show the cross-region fallback path but mark it as "cold-failover - controlled egress".
- Claim language: avoid wording that implies hardware separation unless we have a dedicated NIC-level statement signed off by infra. Prefer "logical separation enforced via VLANs and per-tenant routing with encryption in transit".
- CAIQ mapping: Karthik, can you add the SOC2 evidence IDs (log retention, audit trail links) to the matrix? Naomi, can you confirm the retention window and whether we can provide a sample log extract?

I can take the diagram annotations and produce a clean PDF for Alyssa. Jordan, I'll need the source Visio/Diagrams file if you have it.

Kimberly Park
Director, Security Architectures
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <ay.chen@brightbank.com>, BrightBank Security <security@brightbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T14:42:00-08:00
Subject: Final: Interconnect claim pack for BrightBank (Dedicated)

Hi Alyssa / BrightBank team — attaching the finalized pack per your ask. Summary below and next steps.

Summary of deliverables (attached):
- interconnect_diagram_v3.pdf — final diagram set (3 pages) with CP/DP boundaries, encrypted links labeled, cross-region fallback annotated, and PrivateLink/VPN callouts.
- controlplane_claim_matrix.xlsx — SIG/CAIQ mapping sheet with links to our evidence IDs and SOC 2 references. Note: two CAIQ fields are marked "partial" where the control requires infra-level PCI attestations; we flagged those in column F.
- interconnect_narrative_onepager.docx — one-page narrative stating the claim (control plane logical separation, data plane encryption, egress policing) and pointing to diagram labels CP-1..CP-4.

Statement of attestation: Redwood Inference attests that for Dedicated (reserved capacity) deployments we maintain logical control plane separation from tenant data paths, enforce per-tenant routing and encryption in transit, and retain control-plane audit logs as described in the CAIQ mapping. This is a technical attestation supported by the referenced artifacts; it is not a contractual warranty.

Related links:
- Confluence pack: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/Interconnect+Claim+Pack
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 (deal BB-03942)

Next steps:
- If your reviewers want a brief walkthrough, Naomi and I can do a 30-min call this week.
- Please flag any CAIQ/SIG rows you need more depth on and we'll route to infra/ops.

Thanks — looking forward to your feedback.

Jordan Blake
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Attachments: interconnect_diagram_v3.pdf, controlplane_claim_matrix.xlsx, interconnect_narrative_onepager.docx
